svg.title: Artemia. Keys and transit card pouch in veg-tan leather

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Artemia
A keys and transit card pouch in full-grain vegetable-tanned leather, 4.5 by 3 inches, with a brass swivel hook.
The only mark is the brine shrimp, Utah's state crustacean, blind debossed from a natural-history drawing.

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: In hand. The pouch is about the width of a palm; the shrimp spans most of the front.

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Artemia franciscana
Great Salt Lake brine shrimp, female, with brood sac
Eleven pairs of leaf-shaped legs, two eyes on stalks, a forked tail.
Drawn for a brass die at 2.75 inches; an illustrator who draws
natural history finishes the plate before the die is cut.

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Full grain. Made in Utah. Carry it daily.
Made by [Leatherworker], Salt Lake

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Back: a slot so the transit card taps through the leather. The maker is stamped inside.
Natural
veg-tan, day one
Honey
the same hide, a season in
Ink
black veg-tan

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Blind deboss, no foil, no ink: a shrimp in gold becomes a joke, a shrimp pressed into leather becomes a crest.

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Natural veg-tan starts pale and goes to honey, so the pouch keeps a record of its owner's year.
